THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon(Revised Edition 1956), as amended by Act, Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes (SpecialProvisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 dated 15.07.2011 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri LankaExtraordinary No. 1715/11 dated 20.07.2011 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissionerof Labour dated 24.05.2011.
Mr. H. A. D. Chandrasiri, No. 36, Atampitiya Road, Bandarawela, of the one part
Uva Development Bank, No. 26, Bank Road, Badulla, of the other part
Was referred to Mr. K. R. M. N. Lawrence for Settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, I, W. D. J. Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade UnionRelations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the said Order dated 15.07.2011.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.Colombo,23rd March, 2016.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompanies thisorder exists between,
Mr. H. A. D. Chandrasiri, No. 36, Atampitiya Road, Bandarawela, of the one part
Uva Development Bank, No. 26, Bank Road, Badulla, of the other part .

NOW THEREFORE I, W. D. J. Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vested in me bySection 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended byAct Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes-Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr.R. S. Ariyapperuma, No. 03, Araliya Mawatha, Sirimal Uyana, Ratmalana to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him forsettlement by arbitration.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. H. A. D. Chandrasiri, No. 36, Atampitiya Road, Bandarawela, of the one part
Uva Development Bank, No. 26, Bank Road, Badulla, of the other part
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether it is justified to impose penalties in terms of the internal letter dated 27.04.2007 issued by the General Manager of the UvaDevelopment Bank on Mr. H. A. D. Chandrasiri with regard to the faults said to have committed by him while he was in service as theManager of the Haldummulla Branch which is governed under the said Bank and if not justified, to what reliefs he is entitled.
M. D. C. AMARATHUNGE,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 12th day of March, 2016.

WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompanies thisorder exists between,
Group of Employees including S. P. Anoma Shyamali Kumari, Balagollagama, Balalla of the one part
Central Cultural Fund, No. 212/1, Bauddhaloka Mawatha, Colombo 07 of the other part.

NOW THEREFORE I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powersvested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition),as amended by Act Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes-Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 herebyappoint Mr. T. E. Santharajan, No. 181/1, A. P. T. 503, W. A. Silva Mawatha, Colombo 06 to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid disputeto him for settlement by arbitration.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Group of Empolyees including S. P. Anoma Shyamali Kumari, Balagollagama, Balalla of the one part
Central Cultural Fund, No. 212/1, Bauddhaloka Mawatha, Colombo 07 of the other part
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether the group of employees including S. P. Anoma Shyamali Kumari who had worked in the post of Excavation Conservation Assistantin the places of worship at Yapahuwa, Dambadeniya, Ridee Viharaya (Rideegama) and Nathagane (Panduwasnuwara) of the VayambaSquare of the Central Cultural Fund had been caused injustice by termination from service on 02.11.2015, Confirmation of service of othersin the same capacity and recruitment of outsiders to the same post and if such injustice had been caused, to what reliefs they are entitled.
M. D. C. AMARATHUNGE,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 21st day of March, 2016.
